name: Modanganj
review: Official Bihar land-record reports identify Jehanabad Modanganj, and the live public BhuNaksha viewer resolves the Jehanabad/Modanganj hierarchy. Current anonymous viewer inspection exposed hierarchy and WMS/plot route names, but no safe parcel ID-plus-full-polygon response. Runtime remains held pending serial adapter qualification.
queryAndRequestOutcomes: English and Hindi discovery queries were executed and recorded in the paired city record. Landing page, viewer HTML, configuration, and JavaScript were fetched over TLS. A live hierarchy POST returned district/circle data including Jehanabad code 33 and Modanganj code 05. No credentials, login, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe fields, or TLS exception were used.
